raw: [Subtitle(text="If she still has a mind for such things, perhaps we might finally talk about that wedding that's been put on hold for the past ten years?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]

text: …I soon dismissed that thought as foolish. The woman I once knew now stood before me like a stranger. I could no longer discern what she was thinking.

speaker: Ægir Officer
content: We couldn't reveal our battle plans. We had to retreat.

raw: [name="Ægir Officer"]Our ship was the fastest in the fleet. The most logical tactic was for us to delay the Seaborn while the main fleet retreated.
speaker: Ægir Officer
content: Our ship was the fastest in the fleet. The most logical tactic was for us to delay the Seaborn while the main fleet retreated.

raw: [name="Gladiia"]How many survivors are there on your ship?
speaker: Gladiia
content: How many survivors are there on your ship?

raw: [name="Ægir Officer"]Twenty-six... Less than one in ten.
speaker: Ægir Officer
content: Twenty-six... Less than one in ten.

speaker: Ægir Officer
content: Why the silence, Madame Consul?

speaker: Ægir Officer
content: I see.

raw: [name="Gladiia"]I'm sorry, commander. Your ship and your twenty-six men are the only survivors.
speaker: Gladiia
content: I'm sorry, commander. Your ship and your twenty-six men are the only survivors.

raw: [name="Specter"]All Seaborn inside the ship have been eliminated.
speaker: Specter
content: All Seaborn inside the ship have been eliminated.

raw: [name="Specter"]There's no better way to tell you, so I'll make it brief... the thousand or so men whose retreat you were covering fell into an even bigger ambush.
speaker: Specter
content: There's no better way to tell you, so I'll make it brief... the thousand or so men whose retreat you were covering fell into an even bigger ambush.

raw: [name="Specter"]We happened to see your ship weaving through the complex terrain as we arrived.
speaker: Specter
content: We happened to see your ship weaving through the complex terrain as we arrived.

raw: [name="Specter"]But what you couldn't have seen is the Seaborn had you completely surrounded. You were just chasing your own tail in their trap.
speaker: Specter
content: But what you couldn't have seen is the Seaborn had you completely surrounded. You were just chasing your own tail in their trap.

speaker: Ægir Officer
content: We failed the mission.

raw: [name="Ægir Officer"]Yet we were the ones who lived. The losses are... much worse than expected...
speaker: Ægir Officer
content: Yet we were the ones who lived. The losses are... much worse than expected...

speaker: Gladiia
content: But you did live.

speaker: Gladiia
content: Lift your head, Ægir.

raw: [name="Gladiia"]You and your men are just as much Ægir's elites, and you will give your strength to what's ahead.
speaker: Gladiia
content: You and your men are just as much Ægir's elites, and you will give your strength to what's ahead.

raw: [name="Gladiia"]For now, Laurentina and I will bring you back to the city.
